text:
maria: FYI found ~118 invoices where Stripe shows a usage credit but NetSuite has no credit memo. Seems to come from last night's daily job.

sam: which job window?

maria: midnight run, 00:00-01:00 UTC. Pattern: description field got truncated to 128 chars and the trailing stubline_id we relied on was lost, so netsuite_uploader couldn't find external_id.

maria: logs:
```
INFO 2025-04-02T00:02:10Z batch: scanned 3980 usage rows
WARN 2025-04-02T00:02:12Z sync: stripe_charge_id=ch_7f9 missing stubline_id after truncation
ERROR 2025-04-02T00:02:13Z netsuite_uploader: mapping error: external_id missing -> skip
```

billing-bot: webhook invoice.payment_succeeded ch_7f9 -> /hooks/finance 200 OK

julian: sounds like the DLQ replay path used the legacy serializer that appended stubline to desc. We lowered desc max_len in serializer v2.1 last month.

eric: remediation: reprocess DLQ with corrected serializer and run a NetSuite backfill that is idempotent by stripe_charge_id. Need finance sign-off to write to prod NS.

sam: watch out for duplicates if webhook retries already created memos. Backfill must check for existing external_id based on stripe_charge_id.

maria: plan:
1) pause nightly batch for one run
2) merge serializer fix and reprocess DLQ on staging
3) dry-run backfill then prod during maintenance window 02:00-03:00 UTC
4) rotate creds after done

finance-ops: approve backfill in maintenance window with audit logging and dry-run first.

eric: I'll provision restricted NS role and rotate keys afterward.

julian: PR ready, tests passing.

maria: DRY RUN finished: 118 candidates, 0 writes. sample output:
```
stripe_charge_id,amount,action
ch_101,42.00,create_credit_memo_candidate
ch_102,9.99,create_credit_memo_candidate
ch_103,0.00,create_credit_memo_candidate
```

maria: merging PR and will reprocess DLQ on staging, then run prod backfill in approved window.
